beats.intent: ThinkSR keeps a dense carrier while a compact thought process repeatedly reads and updates it before decoding.
beats.claim: A persistent dense carrier, read and updated by a compact thought process.
beats.narration: ThinkSR separates the spatial carrier from the compact reasoning that updates it. The encoder first turns the low-resolution image into a dense feature field. The window step partitions that field while keeping the spatial tokens available. The shared DQ-CTM block performs repeated thought ticks over those windowed tokens. The decoder turns the updated dense carrier back into the super-resolved image. The recurrence stays inside the thought stage, and the same parameters are reused across ticks.

beats.intent: The carrier starts as dense encoder features, then window partitioning preserves all tokens for the thought process.
beats.narration: The carrier equation defines the dense state before the compact thought process touches it. The encoder maps the low-resolution image into features. The low-resolution image is the input being lifted into that feature field. The feature field is the persistent dense carrier. The window partition produces tokens from the full carrier while keeping every token.
